title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook | 2-1/2-Inch Extension | Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass
description:
Need a place to hang towels and robes without a hook sticking out all the time? This traditional retractable wall hook extends when you need it, then pushes back in to sit close to the wall for a cleaner bathroom look.

Highlights:
- Keep essentials within reach: retractable rod provides 2-1/2" of hanging space
- Reduce bumps in tight bathrooms: retracts to a 1" projection when not in use
- Hang with confidence: supports up to 15 lb
- Match your existing hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Designed for standard interior walls: installs with included toggle mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting: wall mount
- Size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
- Projection: 1"
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Installation: drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; includes 6/32 toggles and mounting hardware
- Finish options: available in multiple designer finish options including statement colors

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
